briefdescription.para: Unified incident taxonomy and structured diagnostics for timeseries module.

detaileddescription.para:
This header defines:
Incident classification (IngestIncident, QueryIncident, LifecycleIncident, IntegrationIncident)
Severity levels and error codes for each incident class
Structured incident emission helpers
Incident metadata and diagnostic context

The taxonomy enables uniform error handling across all timeseries paths:
Ingest: buffer pressure, validation failures, flush timeouts
Query: range errors, timeout, consistency violations
Lifecycle: retention policy violations, key rotation failures
Integration: remote-write failures, metrics export errors

listitem.para: Explicit Classification: Every error maps to exactly one incident class.
No Silent Failures: All errors emit incidents with severity and recovery hints.
Actionable Messages: Operators can diagnose and recover from incidents.
Bounded Performance: Incident emission has bounded latency and allocation.
Structured Output: Incidents carry diagnostic context for logging/tracing.
